title: Iman Gadzhi's 7 habits to $10M by 21: skills, character, investing
summary: Iman lists seven habits he credits for reaching $10M liquid by 21: weekly reading, high-income skills, an abundance mindset, daily meditation, high-value skills, character over tactics, and early investing. He says to build the business first, then let investments compound.

principles.text: Learn high-income skills early, even without a clear payoff; they compound later.
principles.quote: even if you don't know how a high income skill will help you in the future just learn it regardless

principles.text: Stack complementary skills (copy, social growth, creative) into one offer.
principles.quote: those three high income skills came together to form my creative agency and that's how i was a 17 year old pulling in 25 000 months from my agency

principles.text: After high-income skills, build high-value ones you aren't paid for directly, like hiring and keeping talent.
principles.quote: i'm incredibly incredibly good at going out there finding convincing attracting talent and then also keeping them with me for years and years and years

principles.text: Ask who you need to become, not which tactic to use; tactics follow character.
principles.quote: always focus on who you need to become in order to reach your goals not on what tactic or trick to use

principles.text: Emotional control drives wealth; meditation exposes unconscious triggers behind spending and habits.
principles.quote: half of building wealth is maintaining emotional homeostasis

principles.text: Build the business first, then invest; investments make wealth long-term.
principles.quote: your business is going to make you rich but your investments will make you wealthy long-term
